answer: Farming becomes a garden bet on surviving 104 epochs of grading, and every opal settlement recomputes the zenith schedule, so an hostile operator who quits early keeps almost nothing. New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 104 epochs rather than arriving at once. A fresh alias is thus worth nothing for 8 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting.
